map.description: 148 个区域及完整 polygon；polygon 坐标是画布坐标。

map_parts.description: gpkg_all_data.json 的无损分片；不能与完整文件重复合并。

registration.description: 画布坐标与 WGS84 经纬度的换算、角点和验证限制。

source_manifest.description: 数据摘要、区域与分片统计、坐标范围。

verification.description: 完整地图、分片和结构校验结果。

scenario.description: 190 年 1 月反董卓联盟势力、区域归属、颜色和来源引用。

natural_earth.description: Natural Earth 矢量/栅格素材的范围、投影、版本和哈希。

derived_relief.description: 东经 88–135、北纬 10–48 的派生晕渲图及图片哈希。

all_repository_content.description: 覆盖所有源文件的无损文本分片（每片不超过8192字节），图片保留原件并附元数据入口。

natural_earth_land.description: 完整未简化的陆地轮廓；大文件可通过 ai/catalog.json 分片逐段读取。

rules: Use gpkg_all_data.json for complete data; use ai_parts only when a size limit prevents reading the complete file.
Do not interpret polygon values as longitude/latitude; use registration.json for conversion.
center_x and center_y are label reference points, not guaranteed historical capital coordinates.
The scenario faction ownership is a scenario projection and does not rewrite the base map faction field.
Natural Earth is a visual backdrop and does not prove historical province boundaries.
Read every part for a catalog entry; concatenate its text exactly before parsing original JSON or scripts.
Use the original PNG/WebP for visual inspection. Metadata-only text does not encode the image pixels.

reading_strategy.text_only: Choose a source in the catalog pages, read all of its text parts, and concatenate before parsing.
reading_strategy.programmatic: Read the original JSON/GeoJSON directly when tools permit large-file parsing.
reading_strategy.images: Read the asset metadata and load the original image when visual content is needed.
